```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(jsonlite)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r paths}
base_dir <- "/Users/fuminli/Desktop/CARDIAC-FM"
data_path <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "figure_numbers_new",
  "supp_cmr_feature_cox",
  "cmr_feature_cox_external_seed3_stats.json"
)

output_dir <- base_dir
```

```{r load-data}
cmr_cox <- fromJSON(data_path, simplifyDataFrame = TRUE)

feature_order <- c("laef", "lavmax", "lavmin", "lvedv", "lvesv", "lvm", "lvef")
feature_labels <- c(
  laef = "LAEF",
  lavmax = "LAVmax",
  lavmin = "LAVmin",
  lvedv = "LVEDV",
  lvesv = "LVESV",
  lvm = "LVM",
  lvef = "LVEF"
)

outcome_order <- c("af", "hf", "hfref", "hfpef")
outcome_labels <- c(
  af = "AF",
  hf = "HF",
  hfref = "HFREF",
  hfpef = "HFPEF"
)

hr_breaks <- function(x) {
  x <- range(x, finite = TRUE)
  step <- case_when(
    diff(x) <= 0.45 ~ 0.1,
    diff(x) <= 0.90 ~ 0.2,
    TRUE ~ 0.5
  )

  if (diff(x) <= 3 * step) {
    y_min <- floor(x[1] / step) * step
    if (y_min + 3 * step < x[2]) {
      y_min <- ceiling((x[2] - 3 * step) / step) * step
    }
  } else {
    y_mid <- mean(x)
    y_min <- round((y_mid - 1.5 * step) / step) * step
  }

  y_min + 0:3 * step
}

hr_limits <- function(x) {
  breaks <- hr_breaks(x)
  c(min(x, breaks, na.rm = TRUE), max(x, breaks, na.rm = TRUE))
}

chs_plotdata <- cmr_cox$CHS_pred %>%
  filter(feature %in% feature_order, outcome %in% outcome_order) %>%
  mutate(
    feature_label = factor(feature_labels[feature], levels = feature_labels[feature_order]),
    outcome_label = factor(outcome_labels[outcome], levels = outcome_labels[outcome_order])
  )

write_csv(chs_plotdata, file.path(output_dir, "chs_pred_cmr_feature_hr.csv"))
```

```{r plot}
p_chs <- ggplot(chs_plotdata, aes(x = feature_label, y = HR)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "black", linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = HR_low, ymax = HR_high),
    width = 0.08,
    linewidth = 0.45,
    color = "#2A9D8F"
  ) +
  geom_point(color = "#2A9D8F", size = 1.3) +
  facet_grid(outcome_label ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = hr_limits,
    breaks = hr_breaks,
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey93", linewidth = 0.35),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey70", color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, angle = 270),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 8, 5, 5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_chs
```

```{r save-plot}
ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "chs_pred_cmr_feature_hr.png"),
  p_chs,
  width = 7,
  height = 7.5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r load-mesa-data}
mesa_plotdata <- bind_rows(
  cmr_cox$MESA_meas %>% mutate(type = "MRI-measured"),
  cmr_cox$MESA_pred %>% mutate(type = "ECG-predicted")
) %>%
  filter(feature %in% feature_order, outcome %in% outcome_order) %>%
  mutate(
    feature_label = factor(feature_labels[feature], levels = feature_labels[feature_order]),
    outcome_label = factor(outcome_labels[outcome], levels = outcome_labels[outcome_order]),
    type = factor(type, levels = c("MRI-measured", "ECG-predicted"))
  )

write_csv(mesa_plotdata, file.path(output_dir, "mesa_cmr_feature_hr.csv"))
```

```{r plot-mesa}
p_mesa <- ggplot(mesa_plotdata, aes(x = feature_label, y = HR, color = type)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "black", linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = HR_low, ymax = HR_high),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
    width = 0.18,
    linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 1.3) +
  facet_grid(outcome_label ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = hr_limits,
    breaks = hr_breaks,
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("MRI-measured" = "#E76F51", "ECG-predicted" = "#2A9D8F")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Hazard Ratios (95% CI)", color = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey93", linewidth = 0.35),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey70", color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.5),
    strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, angle = 270),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 8, 5, 5)
  )

p_mesa
```

```{r save-mesa-plot}
ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "mesa_cmr_feature_hr.png"),
  p_mesa,
  width = 7,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)
```
